crossRefs.note: For what is the hope of the godless, when he is cut off, when God takes away his life?
Will God hear his cry when trouble comes on him?
The sacrifice made by the wicked is an abomination to Yahweh, but the prayer of the upright is his delight.
Yahweh is far from the wicked, but he hears the prayer of the righteous.
Whoever stops his ears at the cry of the poor, he will also cry out, but shall not be heard.
He who turns away his ear from hearing the law, even his prayer is an abomination.
When you spread out your hands, I will hide my eyes from you. Yes, when you make many prayers, I will not hear. Your…
We know that God doesn’t listen to sinners, but if anyone is a worshiper of God, and does his will, he listens to him.
You ask, and don’t receive, because you ask with wrong motives, so that you may spend it on your pleasures.

translations.web: If I cherished sin in my heart, the Lord wouldn’t have listened.
translations.bsb: If I had cherished iniquity in my heart, the Lord would not have listened.
translations.kjv: If I regard iniquity in my heart, the Lord will not hear
translations.asv: If I regard iniquity in my heart, The Lord will not hear:
